Apply coupon discount to subtotal after volume discount

The coupon percentage/amount was computed on the gross line total
instead of the amount left after the volume discount, so stacking a
volume discount with a coupon took off less than the rules require.
The 50%-of-gross cap is unaffected.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Accept a coupon through its last valid day

The expiry check rejected a coupon on validUntil itself, one day
early: "valid from its first day to its last day, both included"
means validUntil should still be redeemable.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
